rationale: Identity was correctly verified by name+zip and actions were taken on the right account. However, the agent executed returns and a cancellation without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit user confirmation, violating policy. Worse, the agent canceled the entire pending order instead of only the hose, contrary to the user’s instruction (“if cancelling one item is not possible, forget about it”). Although the refund math and breakdown were correct given the actions taken, the order-changing actions themselves were noncompliant. Therefore, fail.
